title: Filtered smash products of cobordism-null restrictions
exact_target: Given a finite pointed CW pair $G\subseteq E$ and a based map $v:E\to S^d$ whose stable restriction to G becomes null after the unit $S\to MU$, does $v^{\wedge \ell }$ become stably null on the union of smash products with at least $ceil(\ell /2)$ factors restricted to G, for every sufficiently large $\ell $?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
